raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
I am a results-driven finance professional specializing in trade and cash operations, transaction reconciliation, and global settlements. With proven expertise in managing high-pressure environments while ensuring compliance with financial regulations, I am recognized for my problem-solving abilities and my commitment to operational excellence. My achievements include receiving the Bravo G Champ Award for outstanding contributions
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Ndx financial services
07/2026 - Present
Mumbai
operation executive

Executed end-to-end trade settlement activities across Equity and Fixed Income products, ensuring accurate trade matching, settlement instruction processing, and timely resolution of settlement exceptions. Prepared and maintained daily settlement and operational reports, including trade status, fail, reconciliation, and exception reports, ensuring accurate reporting to internal teams and stakeholders within SLA timelines. • Monitored trade execution through settlement lifecycle, coordinating with counterparties, custodians, brokers, and internal teams to resolve unmatched trades, settlement breaks, and failed transactions while minimizing operational risk.

Associate II – Trade and Cash Operations
State Street Services Private Ltd
07/2023 - 05/2026
Mumbai, Maharashtra
A leading provider of financial services and investment management
Reconcile cash and trade transactions via SWIFT and fax, ensuring adherence to currency deadlines and compliance guidelines
Manage and resolve client queries using Inquiry Management Tools (IMT), handling escalations efficiently
Process trade and cash reporting, ensuring the clearance of discrepancies before settlement deadlines
Oversee pre-settlements for global markets, monitoring and validating SWIFT MT message types (MT540, MT541, MT542, MT543, MT103, MT202, MT299, MT599, MT N92, MT910)
Generate and validate manual SWIFT messages for equities, bonds, cash payments, receipts, and FX transactions
Ensure compliance with Authority Level Matrix (ALM) and market • deadlines for seamless trade settlements • Train and mentor new employees, facilitating a smooth onboarding process
Handle core accounting settlements for Ireland-based portfolios (~20,000 portfolios), ensuring trades and FX transactions are settled within deadlines
